nodes.label: lazybull.trade Master Strategy — canonical assumptions + 13-section plan
'Options You Can See' — Visual Options category positioning
nodes.rationale: Own an empty shelf ('Visual Options' on-ramp) instead of fighting the crowded analytics/courses/signals shelves. Honest limit stated: the category phrase is a marketing frame, not a moat; the real moat is compliance posture + India wedge + speed + dataset.

nodes.label: The 91% Club India wedge — India free as dataset/trust/SEO beachhead
nodes.rationale: Willingness-to-pay paradox: you cannot charge the 91% who lose money while legally barred from promising profit — so India is free (funnel + dataset, excluded from ARR) and the global USD prosumer wallet is monetized. Paper-only education sim is counter-cyclical to SEBI's live-F&O crackdown.

nodes.label: Paywall decision — AI-teacher daily cap (wall on 6th /api/explain/day) + Quant/workspace saves; paper trades unlimited
nodes.rationale: Resolves a cross-section conflict (one input capped paper trades at 3). Chosen because the AI teacher is the highest-converting surface, capping the core paper-trading 'aha' would depress activation, and a genuinely free tier keeps the dataset flywheel alive. Aha-gate, never cold-gate; card-required 7-day Pro trial at every wall.

nodes.label: Money rail — Merchant-of-Record (Paddle/Lemon Squeezy) global + Razorpay India, one internal getPlan entitlement
nodes.rationale: An India-domiciled entity cannot cleanly sell USD subscriptions on native Stripe. MoR is seller-of-record, handles global tax, pays an Indian bank at ~5% fee (modeled into $25.65 net ARPU). Razorpay KYC is the long pole — submit Day 0; app stays processor-agnostic behind getPlan(userId).

nodes.label: SEBI loss statistic — ~91% of individual F&O traders had net losses, ~₹1.05 lakh crore aggregate FY25
nodes.rationale: Locked as the canonical citation: one owner verifies the filing once, freezes the text, always 'Source: SEBI', never rounded up — un-fakeability is the asset and the entire wedge is built on it.

nodes.label: Fatal flag F1 — signal/sizing copy ('Size up', 'Half-Kelly', 'BUY/SELL fire') = unregistered-adviser exposure
nodes.rationale: Personalized buy/sell + position-sizing language pierces the Lowe v. SEC publisher exclusion and trips SEBI RA regs; a fee strengthens the adviser argument. Fix: strip action verbs and sizing terms, rewrite to past-tense impersonal hypotheticals. If only one thing is fixed, fix this.

nodes.label: Fatal flag F2 — undelayed live Yahoo data served to India IPs violates SEBI lag rule + Yahoo ToS
nodes.rationale: At the first paid charge 'personal use' is gone — the site becomes a commercial redistributor of an unlicensed scrape. Fix: geo-gate India IPs to EOD/lagged data and license a ToS-clean feed before charging on data.

nodes.label: Fatal flag F3 — public hypothetical performance claims, headlined by the live value={77} 'ultra-tier accuracy %' stat
nodes.rationale: Hypothetical/backtested performance on an unrestricted retail page is performance advertising (SEC posture; FTC deception exposure per Online Trading Academy $362M). The 77% also contradicts the canonical 55.5–66% band — an internally inconsistent accuracy claim is itself a diligence landmine. Remove or disclaim the 77% first; rank on mastery, never accuracy.

nodes.label: Decision-trace dataset flywheel — behavioral 'how beginners learn options' dataset with confusion heuristic
nodes.rationale: The un-clonable asset: competitors can bolt on 'AI explains this trade' in weeks but not 'AI that remembers this user confused theta with delta three sessions ago'. Logging starts day one of Phase 1 with schema_version, explicit DPDP-compliant consent (unconsented traces are discounted to zero in diligence), and a written confusion heuristic. The fine-tune needs ~1,000+ clean confusion-resolution tuples or it degrades to a few-shot prompt library.

nodes.label: Claude migration — move every teaching surface off OpenAI to the Claude family (Haiku teacher, Sonnet copilot, Opus NL-to-strategy)
nodes.rationale: Pedagogical quality on multi-paragraph explanation IS the product; prompt caching on a frozen system prompt collapses per-call cost; Haiku-class pricing is competitive with Sonnet/Opus headroom. Swap route.ts:73, add streaming, preserve the 'source: mock' fallback exactly.

nodes.label: Engineered tuck-in exit — acquisition at ~$2.5–3.5M ARR ($10–20M floor, $24–36M conditional, ~$70M tail)
nodes.rationale: For a 3-person capital-light India team, acquisition (Sensibull→Zerodha, Composer→SoFi templates) is more probable than grinding B2C to $10M ARR. Buyers pay for four conditional assets: behavioral dataset (needs consent), one dependent broker, compliance-clean brand, AI-narrated workbench. Revenue is the credibility engine, not the prize.

nodes.label: Pricing ladder — Free / Plus $19 / Pro $39 / Power $59; launch builds only Free+Pro; India ₹399/₹799 excluded from ARR
nodes.rationale: Anchor down: show Pro $39 first so Plus reads reasonable and Power makes Pro look mid. Scope discipline for 3 people: only two gating states (free/paid) get built before the first dollar clears; Power ships Phase 2 only after a real IV feed exists ($39–59 is not credible on synthetic IV).

nodes.label: Canonical model-accuracy band — 55.5% (LOW) to 66% (ULTRA) out-of-sample, verified in serve.py
nodes.rationale: One band, everywhere. The live 77% stat is wrong/unsourced and must be removed or disclaimed first — the highest-risk string on the site. The ensemble is framed permanently as pedagogy ('watch 6 models disagree'), never as an oracle.

nodes.label: Paper-only, no-signals, lagged-data posture — the compliance moat
nodes.rationale: The single greatest legal asset: no real funds, no order routing, no cash prizes, ever — keeps the company out of adviser/broker-dealer/money-transmitter territory and politically aligned with SEBI. The safe harbor is conditional: it holds only while content stays impersonal, hypothetical, non-transactional.

nodes.label: Founder team — Shaurya Negi (engine/backend/payments), Joshmann Singh (product/design/frontend), Pratham Verma (ops/compliance/users); NST students
'Source: Mock' honesty pattern — label every synthetic number
nodes.rationale: Labeling a synthetic number is a radical trust signal in a fraud-soaked category and non-optional while shipping mock/lagged data; the mock fallback must be preserved exactly through the Claude migration and is even marketed as a trust pillar.

hyperedges.label: AI-teacher monetization flow: the paywall decision gates POST /api/explain (6th call/day) via a plan field to be added to the NextAuth session, instrumented against proFunnel's five funnel labels, priced by the Free/Pro ladder, charged over the MoR + Razorpay rail

Three fatal compliance flags that flip the paper-only moat into liability at the first paid charge: F1 signal/sizing copy, F2 undelayed Yahoo data to India, F3 public 77% performance claim — all must be fixed before the first charge
